sources.title: How to install and run Erebus? : r/KoboldAI - Reddit
sources.snippet: I recommend making at least about 128GB drive space available to store the model and have a decent swap file. Using SSD space will make it load much faster, but won't affect the run time much. Then, reboot and install linux on this free space. (On a separate partition). Choose to install the proprietary nVidia drivers when this is asked.
